prompts: A tight close-up shot, fixed macro lens, inside a 24-hour convenience store during a late-night rainstorm. Lin Mo, a slim tall young man with slightly messy black short hair, thin-framed glasses, a faint scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wears a dark blue hoodie with a red lanyard store badge, stands behind the checkout counter. Cold white fluorescent light reflects off his glasses. He looks down sorting merchandise, fingers suddenly freeze mid-air, then he slowly lifts his head, eyes alert and hesitant. Rain streaks the dark window behind him. High contrast cool-toned lighting, horizontal landscape composition. Continuous five-second motion: fingers stop, head rises, glasses catch the light.

A tall, lean young man with slightly messy black short hair, thin-rimmed glasses, a faint scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue hoodie with a red lanyard holding a convenience-store name badge, black cargo pants and white sneakers, walks hesitantly from the brightly lit interior of a 24-hour convenience store toward a rain-streaked glass door. Shot in medium shot, handheld camera following behind him, slight sway. He stops close to the glass, leans in to peer out. Outside is a pitch-black night with heavy rain and an empty street, no people visible. Cold white fluorescent light inside contrasts with the dark blue-black exterior. High contrast, cool color grade, tense and lonely mood.

A tall, thin young man with slightly messy black short hair, thin-framed glasses, a faint scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue hooded sweatshirt with a red lanyard holding a convenience-store name badge, black cargo pants and white sneakers, stands near the glass door inside a 24-hour convenience store on a stormy night. Cold white fluorescent light falls on him from above; outside the glass is pitch black with heavy rain streaking down. Low-angle medium close-up, camera slowly pushes in. He turns his head sharply back toward the door, eyes wide in fear. On the glass, faint handprints of condensation bloom outward, spreading slowly and glistening. Rainwater distorts the dark outside. The scene is tense, cold-toned, high-contrast. 832x480 landscape.

Handheld wide shot, 832x480 landscape, slight low angle. A 24-hour convenience storefront at night in a modern city, torrential rain slashing down, cold white fluorescent light spilling from the glass windows onto the wet pavement, the street beyond pitch black. A thin, tall young man with slightly messy black short hair, thin-framed glasses, a pale scar at the tail of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue hoodie with a red lanyard holding a store badge on his chest, black cargo pants and white sneakers, grits his teeth and shoves the glass door open, stepping out into the downpour. Rain instantly soaks his hoodie as he spins his head left and right, searching the empty street, water streaming off his hair and glasses. The camera circles him unsteadily, following his panicked glance. Finding no one, he jerks backward through the doorway, pulling the door shut behind him.

A close-up, eye-level shot inside a 24-hour convenience store at night, heavy rain streaming down the glass door behind. Lin Mo, a lean tall young man with slightly messy black short hair, thin-framed glasses, a faint scar at the end of his left eyebrow, wearing a dark blue hoodie with a red lanyard store badge, stands facing the glass. He has just turned from the door, his expression shifting to extreme fear and disbelief. In the glass reflection, a tall thin figure with long wet black hair covering the face, wearing a soaked black long coat and barefoot, slowly raises a pale hand. Lin Mo's own reflection is absent. Cold white fluorescent light contrasts with the black rainy night outside. The camera holds steady as focus racks from Lin Mo's face to the reflection. Rain streaks blur the glass, which trembles slightly. 832x480 landscape.
